repo.description:
### Impact

A stored HTML injection vulnerability was found in the email and chat-summary rendering path for video posts. When a provider-controlled video title contains markup, the title could be re-parsed as HTML when Discourse generates email notifications or chat summaries for the post. A malicious video title could result in the injection of arbitrary HTML into the rendered email or chat summary, potentially including browser-executable event handlers.

The attack requires:
- The attacker has standard posting privileges (TL1 account)
- Lazy video embeds are enabled (this is the default)
- The relevant video provider (YouTube, Vimeo, or TikTok) is enabled

Recipients viewing the affected email in HTML-capable clients could see injected content. The impact is limited to the email/chat-summary rendering context; it does not directly expose data from a Discourse session or affect the forum itself.

### Workarounds

If immediate upgrade is not possible, disabling lazy video embeds (setting `lazy_videos_enabled` to `false`) prevents the vulnerable rendering path from being reached.
repo.summary: Stored HTML injection in video notification emails
